changes: AV Laptop is optional: automatic app registration through cavida_bridge or a standalone window using /davidcrypto and the OpenApp export.
Requires cavida_bridge 1.3.0: framework, inventory, banking, device access and networks are handled by the shared bridge.
Supports Qbox, QBCore, ESX and standalone through bridge adapters; AK47 is optional with native banking as an alternative.
K4MB1 is optional: GTA cabinets, hardware proxies and peripherals provide backup visuals while preserving existing racks and coins.
Use hardware through inventory, framework usable-item callbacks or the F7 menu inside your warehouse.
Installation examples for ox_inventory, QBCore and ESX; Escape and a close button for the standalone window.
Shared Cavida bridge update checker: new versions, changelogs and download links in the server console.
Register through cavida_bridge:RegisterResource; automatic checks and the cavida_updates console command.
Power state survives logout and server/resource restarts; expired internet contracts renew automatically.
Online earnings remain at 100%, offline earnings at 40% while the server is running.
Installation ZIP contains only the resource, compiled UI and installation files.
